rows.text: NID’s Sambalpur account shows the design taking shape before weaving. Yarn is marked with a handmade measuring scale, then tied where colour must be kept out. To add another colour, already coloured sections are bound and selected sections opened for the next dye bath. The prepared threads are woven into the intended design. This account describes cotton and bought synthetic dyes; it does not establish the fibre or dyes of every Bandha textile.
